parsed.rationale: A specific new analyst receives an 'access denied' message after accepting an invite, while other users can log in normally. This is an account/workspace access issue requiring human support to troubleshoot and resolve.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — sorry you’re running into this. Since other users can sign in normally but this specific newly invited analyst gets an “access denied” message after accepting the invite, this looks like an account/workspace permission or invitation-related issue for that user, and we’ll need a support engineer to review it.

To get this fixed as quickly as possible today, could you reply with:
1) The workspace name (or workspace ID) the analyst is trying to access.
2) The exact text of the “access denied” message (verbatim) and whether it appears on the login page or after she reaches the app dashboard.
3) The analyst’s email address (the one that accepted the invite).
4) Invitation details: approximately what time she accepted (and your time zone).
5) Auth method used for your tenant (SSO or email/password), if you know.
6) Any screenshots or error codes from her browser session (if available).

Once we have the above, we’ll escalate internally for immediate investigation and work with you to restore her workspace access today.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to a support engineer for investigation.
Work with you to restore the analyst’s workspace access today once we have the requested details.
safety_notes: Avoid claiming root cause or providing a guaranteed fix time; only promise escalation/investigation and assisting to restore access.
Request minimum missing information to narrow the workspace, exact error, and identity/auth method.

parsed.customer_impact: The analyst cannot access the workspace, blocking their ability to perform work until access is restored.
grounded_facts: A new analyst was invited yesterday.
The new analyst accepted the invitation.
After accepting the invite, the new analyst receives an “access denied” message.
Other users are able to log in normally.
The request asks for assistance to get the analyst into the workspace today.
missing_information: Which workspace/application this refers to (name or identifier).
Exact wording of the “access denied” message (verbatim) and where it appears (login page vs. after login).
Whether the account was invited with correct role/permissions for the workspace.
Whether the invite email/account address is confirmed to be the correct analyst identity.
Time zone and exact time of invitation acceptance.
Whether any error codes, screenshots, or logs are available from the system or from the user’s session.
What authentication method is used (e.g., SSO vs. email/password), if applicable.
Whether the issue affects only this analyst or additional recently invited users.
risk_signals: High urgency for resolving access for an onboarding/on-duty analyst.
Potential onboarding delay due to account/workspace permission or invitation handling issues.
Ambiguity about whether this is isolated to one user or indicates a broader access/permission problem.
parsed.summary: A newly invited analyst receives an 'access denied' message after accepting the invite, while other users can log in normally, and support is needed to restore workspace access today.
